_comment: Run on examples/title-block-demo.dwg. Builds examples/sheet-A3.dwt: one layout 'A3' with the demo title block in paper space and a viewport covering the drawing area. create_section_views placement:production uses it to lay section views out sheet by sheet (the native 'Create Multiple Section Views' path).

ops._viewport_note: x,y = viewport centre on the paper (mm)
